Families have the opportunity to socialize while children develop new skills in an early learning environment. This program is offered in partnership with the Malvern Family Resource Centre (MFRC) . This is a drop-in program. No registration required.

events.title: Family Time

events.title: EarlyON Music and Movement

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for stories, songs, rhymes and activities in this program for children ages 5 and under and their parents or caregivers. Family Time runs from 10:30 to 11:30 am. Drop in. No registration required, but space is limited.

events.title: Saturday Movie: The Girl Who Cried Pearls and Higglety Piggley
events.description: Due to Hillcrest Library closure on July 27, this event will be postponed until January 2027. In Montreal, at the dawn of the 20th century, a poor boy falls in love with a girl whose sorrow turns into pearls. He sells them to a ruthless pawnbroker, who hungers for more. Tempted by greed, the boy must choose between love and fortune. The choice could damn his soul. Join our Youth Chess Program to learn new skills, play matches, and connect with others!  This program is open to youth ages 7-17 years old. Facilitated by the University of Toronto Scarborough Chess Club. No registration required. Space is limited.

events.title: December Acrylic Paint Night
events.description: Join this casual painting session and create your own masterpiece! Theme: Christmas Supplies will be provided, including canvas boards, acrylic paints and brushes. Please note that this is not an art class. Participants will paint by watching and following a step-by-step tutorial video together. Registration is required. Please register online. Visit or call the branch if you need help with registering.

events.title: Lunch @ the Library
events.description: Looking for something fun to do at lunch? Join us at Riverdale Library every Tuesday and Thursday for games, creative activities, crafts, and more. Meet up with friends, relax, and have fun all lunch period long. Drop in. For teens only.

events.title: Knitting and Crochet Circle
events.description: Spend an afternoon at our weekly drop-in knitting and crochet circle! Bring your work in progress and enjoy visiting with other knitters and crocheters. A great place to show off your work, get advice, swap ideas, or just relax and visit with fellow fiber enthusiasts. Beginners and all ages welcome! A limited supply of materials will be available.

events.title: Youth Hub: Pomodoro Study Hall

September 24: The Lincoln Lawyer (2011, 14A) October 1: Knives Out (2019, 14A) October 8: The Ice Storm (1997, R) October 22: Aliens (1986, 14+) October 29: Scream (1996, 18A)  All are welcome. Drop-in, no registration required.

events.description: Learn to Play Dungeons and Dragons! This is a drop-in, learn-to-play program for teens . Space limited. 1st Level Pre-generated character available. All supplies provided. Register in-person in the Youth Hub at 4:30PM.

Explore the impact these experiences can have on mental health and well-being, learn practical strategies, and connect with others in a supportive, non-judgmental environment.
